{{Quote|Get yourselves to the escape pods. I will deal with Grievous here.''"<br />"''But sir, they're commando droids!''"<br />"''That does not matter, Captain. Now go!|Eeth Koth and Lock|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
'''Lock''', designated '''CC-4142''', was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] serving under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] in [[Horn Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Koth's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']]&mdash;with Lock on board&mdash;was [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|attacked]] near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] aboard his [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Separatist destroyer]]. During the ensuing engagement, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Lock and some of his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] assumed defensive positions at one of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]] shortly before [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] used an armored [[Docking tube/Legends|docking tube]] to board the Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]]. As Lock and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fought the intruders, Koth contacted Lock from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], asking for a status report. When Lock reported to him that they were being overrun, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master ordered the captain and his men to board the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], and Lock obeyed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Status report.''"<br />"''There's too many of them!|Eeth Koth and Lock|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />}}
[[File:LockUnderAttack-GI.jpg|thumb|left|250px|General Koth watches as Lock and his troops attempt to repel the invaders.]]
Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="SWE" /> [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] CC-4142,<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" /> nicknamed Lock,<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="clone troopers" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref> Lock served under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> in [[Horn Company]] on board the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']],<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" /> a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> on a mission to hunt down [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agents.<ref name="Jedi Heroes">''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi Heroes]]''</ref> During a patrol deep in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue" /> near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]],<ref name="FF-2014 21" /> Koth's ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|came under attack]] by a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;consisting of three [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and a [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Separatist destroyer]]&mdash;under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

After a short exchange of broadside [[Laser/Legends|fire]], Grievous's [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] forced Koth's [[Warship/Legends|warship]] into submission, and the Separatist [[Troop/Legends|troops]] prepared to board the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|vessel]]. To counter the enemy attack, Lock and his troops assumed defensive positions at one of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]]. [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] then used an armored [[Docking tube/Legends|docking tube]] to board and storm the cruiser. A [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued between the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and Lock's men, and during the skirmish, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was contacted by Koth, who was on the cruiser's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Koth demanded a status report, and Lock reported that they couldn't hold their position any longer. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master then ordered the troopers to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and stated his intention to deal with Grievous on the bridge. The captain objected to this course of action, warning Koth of the advancing [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]]<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> before obeying.<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" />

==Personality and traits==
Lock showed visible concern for Koth and objected when the Jedi Master expressed his intention to engage Grievous separately on the bridge of the Star Destroyer.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> Although Lock and his troops valiantly<ref name="Hasbro Lock">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=(K-Mart Exclusive) Clone Captain Lock|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWEXCaptainLock.asp}}</ref> tried to stop the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' advance, they were unable to prevent the super battle droids from boarding the ship.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> Like his clone imprint, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="clone troopers" /> Lock stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
In combat, Lock used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with green markings, and he had equipped his [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] with a visor.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lock first appeared in "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]]. Although he was not named in the episode, he received a name in its corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]]. Lock was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who portrays all clone troopers in the series.<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue" /> Lock received the designation "CC-4142" in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts" />
